CustomField.description: Created from JIRA ticket: BOPI-358. Updated for BOPI-868 to correct formula issue
CustomField.formula: IF(AND(SBQQ__ListPrice__c = 0, NOT(ISNULL(Quoted_Price__c))), Quoted_Price__c, IF(SBQQ__ListPrice__c = 0, -1* SBQQ__TotalDiscountAmount__c , SBQQ__ListPrice__c *(1- SBQQ__TotalDiscountRate__c )))
